Title: Skipping Walks Because You're Afraid of Falling? - 3 Habits That Break the Cycle

Description:
Cutting back on walks to feel safer can actually raise your fall risk — muscles and balance reflexes weaken from disuse. The CDC says 1 in 4 adults over 65 falls every year. Balance and strength training can cut fall rates by up to 34%, on top of home safety fixes and a yearly medication review.
